title: DAY 6 — LESSON 2: PUNCTUALITY AND KEEPING COMMITMENTS

questions.prompt: What does punctuality mean in the workplace?
options: Being present, prepared and ready at the agreed time

questions.prompt: What should an employee do when she realises she may arrive late?
options: Communicate promptly through the appropriate channel
Wait until someone asks where she is

questions.prompt: A receptionist promises a client a callback but cannot obtain the required information on time. What should she do?
options: Pretend the information has been confirmed
Provide an honest update and arrange a realistic follow-up
Agreeing to every request regardless of capacity
Making realistic commitments and fulfilling them consistently

questions.prompt: What does the READY method encourage?
options: Review schedules, Estimate time, Act early, Deliver commitments and Yield honest updates
Rush, Excuse, Avoid, Delay and Yell
Relax, Expect reminders, Arrive late, Deny and Yield responsibility
